text: Introduction The specialty of Material Science and Engineering is the state key discipline. This program is targeted to cultivate advanced talents to undertake research, teaching and engineering technology and management of Material Science and Engineering and also innovative in all those fields with a profound theoretical knowledge, fundamental skills in experimentation and systematical comprehension of the field of Material Science and Engineering. The Teaching team is mainly composed of teachers who possess an experience of studying at top Euramerican universities and have rich experience in how to teach and instruct international students. Some courses are taught by scholars of well-known Euramerican universities. This program could be taught both in English and Chinese. Master students could choose to be taught in Chinese or English language based on their own situation, and their degree dissertation could be chosen to be written in Chinese or English. Teaching Objectives The program is for candidates with science and engineering backgrounds who have the drive to: • Lead technology development and engineering • Create new technology-enabled ventures • Develop business technology strategies • Design policies to encourage technological innovation Research Orientation Ecological building materials and its key technology, High-performance metals and engineering, Advanced polymer materials and engineering, New composite materials and engineering, Biomedical Materials and Engineering, New composite material technology, Material molding new technology, Photoelectron and information material, New energy materials and technology Note: Masters' Degree Programs for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program. Main courses Engineering Graphics, Fundamental of Material Science Engineering Mechanics, Introduction of Materials Science & Engineering Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Material Chemistry Fundamentals of Machine Design, Thermodynamics of Materials Inorganic Chemistry, Methodology of Materials Science Analytical Chemistry, Methods of Materials Testing Physical Chemistry, Computer in Materials Science Technology Internship Practice,coursedesign,surveyingandmappingpractice,graduationpractice,graduationdesign. Degree Award Students are required to complete the curriculum in 2.5, fulfill the designated degree courses, complete the master's thesis and defend of it in front of a panel of experts. Graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the Master’s degree Career The E&TIM program equips students for meaningful careers as leaders in innovation and the strategic management of technology.
